title: Between two jobs
tagline: A buffer, a budget and your pension rights in order while your income changes.
trigger: Salary payments stopped without a new income, or a first salary from a new employer.

steps.title: Your safety buffer
steps.description: How many months your money covers, and a separate buffer pot.
steps.why: Based on your own balances and spending; nothing is shared.

win.customer: Peace of mind in a stressful time

steps.result: Your current account covers about {buffer_months} months of spending.

steps.title: A temporary budget
steps.description: Pause investment plans, review subscriptions and keep a small safety margin on the account.
steps.why: You confirm every change; nothing is cancelled for you.

win.customer: Spending matched to the new income

steps.result: Temporary budget set. Your investment plan is paused until the next salary.

steps.title: Your pension rights
steps.description: What happens with the group insurance from your previous employer, and whether to keep saving for your pension.
steps.why: Supplementary pension rights usually stay yours when you change jobs; we check the options.
steps.result: Pension overview ready: rights from your previous employer listed.

steps.title: Keep the documents
steps.description: Your last pay slips, employment certificates and contracts in your digital vault.
steps.why: You will need them for benefits and your next tax return.
steps.result: Pay slips and certificates filed in your digital vault.
